name: HJ Science Co., Ltd.
summary: HJ Science Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company in Chengdu, founded in 2017 by Ji Jianxin, that researches small molecule drugs for tumors and autoimmune and metabolic diseases. It handles drug design, activity evaluation, metabolism studies, synthesis, quality research, formulation and scale-up. Its candidates include HJ787, HJ178 and HJ891.
